twitter.lead: Understand the news, not just the facts

linkedin.title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat everyone the same.
linkedin.body:
We have spent the last decade building algorithms that prioritize engagement above all else. The result is a feed that feels less like a window to the world and more like a mirror of our worst habits. It feeds us outrage and repetition because that is what keeps us scrolling.

But news should serve a different purpose. It should help us understand the world better, not just occupy our time. Truly personalised news does not mean trapping you in a bubble of opinions you already hold. It means respecting your intelligence and your time by filtering out the noise that does not matter to you.

Imagine a news experience that actually learns what you care about, whether that is climate policy, local tech startups, or global markets. It should surface deep analysis when you want it and quick summaries when you are busy. It is about curation that feels human, driven by technology that works for the reader instead of the advertiser.

We are building that at Headlinne. We believe the future of news is not about more content, but about better, more relevant content.

reels.hook: President Trump Signs Executive Order to Create US Space Academy

beats.caption: President Trump Signs Executive Order to Create US Space Academy
A new training ground for the next generation of space workers.
beats.detail: President Trump signed a new executive order.
beats.narration: President Trump just signed an executive order to create the first ever U.S. Space Academy.

beats.caption: It aims to strengthen the nation's growing space workforce.
beats.detail: Space is a critical domain for national security.
beats.narration: This is about training the workforce needed for national security and economic growth.

beats.caption: The academy will prepare future leaders for roles in space.
beats.detail: Developing talent for science and the economy.
beats.narration: The goal is to develop talent across science and the economy to keep the U.S. competitive.

beats.caption: Officials say space is vital for American economic growth.
beats.detail: A critical domain for the modern era.
beats.narration: Officials emphasize that space is now a critical domain for American prosperity and global standing.

beats.caption: Six independent sources have confirmed this development.
beats.detail: Reported by NASA and major news outlets.
beats.narration: This news has been verified by six independent sources, including NASA and major global news outlets.

beats.caption: It effectively signals a shift in how we prioritize space.
beats.detail: Education and training are now top priorities.
beats.narration: It signals a major shift in how the country prioritizes education and training for the final frontier.

story_card.headline: Nepal and Tibet face massive flash flood crisis
story_card.standfirst: Death toll rises and search efforts intensify after devastating floods in the region.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: At least 589 people are dead and 1,924 are missing following severe flash floods in Nepal and Tibet.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Sudden flooding caused widespread destruction. The number of missing people rose by over 400 recently.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This disaster highlights the extreme vulnerability of the region to sudden, deadly weather events.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Rescue operations are resuming now. The Nepali army is leading the ongoing search for missing people.

story_card.caption:
Here is the latest update on the Nepal and Tibet flash flood situation and the ongoing rescue operations.
